name: Wyvern
descr: A two-legged dragon that flies from its mountaintop aerie to devour livestock.

data.motivesAndTactics: Cast a long shadow, snatch and grab, wheel through the air

features.name: Double Strike
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Wyvern make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Terrifying Shriek
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Wyvern let out a spine-chilling screech. All PCs within Far range are _Terrified_ until they succeed on a Presence Roll (18) to clear the condition or the Wyvern is defeated. While _Terrified_, a PC doesn't gain a Hope when they roll with Hope.

features.name: Clutch
features.text: When the Wyvern makes a successful attack against a PC, you can **spend a Fear** to have the Wyvern _Restrain_ the target in its claws until the PC succeeds on a Strength Roll (18) or the Wyvern takes Major or greater damage. While _Restrained_ in this way, the PC has disadvantage on attack rolls.
